core_obligations: Pass to a bounded injective representative: choose a quasi-isomorphism onto a bounded complex of injectives, whose localisation is again a bounded complex of injectives, so the localised complex has finite injective dimension (proof lines 2957-2963)
Finiteness of cohomology: flatness of the localisation identifies the cohomology of the localised complex with the localisation of the cohomology, hence it is finite (proof lines 2964-2967)
The duality map: commutation of internal hom with flat base change shows that the canonical map from the ring is a quasi-isomorphism, which is the remaining axiom (proof lines 2968-2973)
proof_roadmap: 取 ω_A^• → I^• 为到有界内射复形的拟同构 ⇒ S^{-1}I^• 是 B 上的有界内射复形 ⇒ ω_A^• ⊗_A B 有限内射维数。
由 A → B 平坦，H^i(ω_A^• ⊗_A B) = H^i(ω_A^•) ⊗_A B ⇒ 上同调有限。
由内射同态与平坦基变换可交换（跨章引理），B → RHom_A(ω_A^• ⊗_A B, ω_A^• ⊗_A B) 是拟同构 ⇒ 满足最后一条公理。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the localisation of a dualizing complex is again a dualizing complex over the localised ring (author lemma at source lines 2949-2955, label lemma-dualizing-localize). The proof (source lines 2957-2974) passes to a bounded injective representative, reads off finiteness of the cohomology from flatness, and verifies the duality axiom through the base change statement for internal homs (proof lines 2957-2973). The verification of the three axioms is the substance. H3.
